newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures remain down on US factory orders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures remain down on US factory orders.

text.p: May 6 - U.S. debt futures remained lower on U.S. March factory orders. Orders fell 1.6 percent, in-line with avg trade estimates for down 1.5 pct. Feb orders were downwardly revised to show a gain of 0.4 pct, from 0.8 pct. Trade was extremely quiet. December Euros become lead contract month on Thursday. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750))
